policy.purpose: Human/AI-assisted review decisions for promoting terminology into the canonical locked registry.
policy.safety: Nothing in terminology_review_queue.json is locked automatically. Only explicit action=lock decisions in this file may modify term_registry.json.
policy.conflicts: Applying a lock must fail if any locked alias already maps to a different Vietnamese target or if the requested term ID conflicts with an existing locked concept.

actions.lock: Promote an explicitly reviewed mapping into term_registry.json.
actions.defer: Record that the item was reviewed but should remain unresolved for now; no registry write.
actions.ignore: Record that the candidate should not become canonical terminology; no registry write.
